subject: Vendr onboarding: evidence segmentation & QA request
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>; Luke Townsend <l.townsend@vendr.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding: evidence segmentation & QA request

Hi Luke / Vendr team,

Thanks for the kickoff call earlier — Peregrine is moving through procurement and we need a small set of clarifications before we can mark the Whistic profile as complete. Two asks from our side: segmentation of the evidence bundle and a quick QA checklist so our security operations team can validate mappings to SIG/CAIQ controls.

Specifically:
- Can you split the evidence into three buckets (policy artifacts, operational proofs, and runbook/log samples) and provide a short manifest that maps each file to SIG/CAIQ control IDs?
- For the manifest, we require a SHA256 hash per file and a single-line provenance statement (who uploaded, timestamp, and the presign URL TTL).
- For any SOC 2 artifacts: confirm whether redacted copies are allowed and, if so, provide the redaction policy you apply.

I've attached a suggested mapping workbook (sig_mapping.xlsx) and a presign instructions PDF showing our preferred TTLs and S3 path format. Ben and Rishi are on copy for QA acceptance criteria.

Target timeline: if you can share the segmented manifest + first bucket within 48 hours, that should keep Peregrine’s timeline intact.

Thanks — will follow up with a short mutual action plan if you confirm timelines.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Partner, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: sig_mapping.xlsx (Excel workbook), presign_instructions.pdf (PDF)

From: Luke Townsend <l.townsend@vendr.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: evidence segmentation & QA request

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear asks, we can do that. A few clarifying questions before we start slicing artifacts: 

1) Data residency tiers — you reference US vs EU in the workbook. Peregrine wants to see "tiered residency" labels on artifacts (e.g., US, EU, US-Restricted). Do you want us to embed that in the manifest per-file or maintain a separate mapping column?

2) Hashing algorithm — we usually publish MD5 + SHA1 for legacy reasons; we'll add SHA256 as requested but want to confirm whether you need signed manifests (e.g., KMS signing) or plain hash values are sufficient for QA.

3) SOC 2 redaction — our legal team prefers to provide redacted PDFs by default; can you confirm the level of redaction that passes your procurement (for example, redaction of customer names vs. redaction of entire incident descriptions)?

We'll start with the policy artifacts bucket and provide a manifest row for each file. We can also presign a small sample S3 object to demonstrate the TTL and presign flow — would you like that included in the first delivery?

Cheers,
Luke Townsend
Security Program Lead, Vendr
l.townsend@vendr.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Luke Townsend <l.townsend@vendr.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: evidence segmentation & QA request

Thanks Luke — answers inline below.

1) Please embed the residency tier as a manifest column (file-level). We need automated ingestion on our side and file-level attributes simplify indexing. Use the labels: US, EU, US-RESTRICTED.

2) SHA256 is mandatory. A signed manifest is preferred for chain-of-custody but not required on first pass — if you can provide a KMS key thumbprint (or KMS alias) and state whether the manifest was signed with that key, that covers the provenance requirement without delaying delivery.

3) SOC 2 redaction policy: redaction of customer names and IP addresses is okay; redact only PII and customer-identifying fields. Incident timelines and control evidence (screenshots, logs) should remain intact. Please include a note in the manifest for any file that contains redactions.

Yes — include a presigned sample object in the first delivery. For QA acceptance: Rishi, can you confirm the minimum artifacts we need from each bucket?

Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> replied separately with a short checklist:
- Policies: master PDF, revision history, author, and policy owner contact
- Operational proofs: architecture diagram (PDF), network ACL screenshots, config export (redacted)
- Logs / runbook samples: 7-day sample audit logs (truncated), one incident runbook (redacted)

If you can provide the first two policy files + manifest row + presign link by EOD Thursday (2026-06-11), that will keep Peregrine on track.

Thanks — we appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Kimberly

From: Luke Townsend <l.townsend@vendr.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Security <security@vendr.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 16:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding: evidence segmentation & QA request

Kimberly / team — quick update and attachments:

1) Delivered bucket: policy_artifacts/ (2 files)
   - vendr-security-policy-v2.1.pdf (SHA256: 3b7f2a9c... )
   - vendr-data-classification.pdf (SHA256: a9f1c2d1... )

2) Manifest: vendr_manifest_bucket1.csv (CSV column set = file_path,sha256,residency_tier,control_ids,uploader,timestamp,presign_ttl_ksec,redacted)
   - Note: manifest is unsigned; KMS alias = alias/vendr-manifests, we can provide a signed manifest for later cycles.

3) Presigned sample: https://s3-presign.vendor.example/vendr/sample-presign.txt?X-EXAMPLE (TTL: 3600s)

4) SOC 2 redaction: we redacted customer names and IPs in the operational evidence per the policy; marked "redacted=TRUE" on the manifest rows. We did not redact incident timelines.

Attachments included in this email: vendr_manifest_bucket1.csv (CSV), small-presign-demo.txt (text file).

Let us know if you want the manifest signed today — we can call the KMS team but it would likely add 24 hours.

Thanks,
Luke
